name: @gjsify/integration-chalk
description: Integration tests: chalk on GJS and Node. Validates ANSI escape-code generation + level gating end-to-end — every CLI tool depends on chalk, so this locks in the @gjsify/{tty,process} color/TTY-detection contract chalk uses through supports-color.

scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
